title: The chart on the report page: show/hide, filters, matches the Dashboard
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. Open each report that has an embedded chart: Sales, Service Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization (seed data so each has a figure).
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the report page shows its matching chart above the report's detail table, with a 'Show chart' / 'Hide chart' control.
2. Confirm the embedded chart reflects the report's own active filters (date range and technician/advisor selection) and shows the same figures as the report it sits on.
3. Toggle show/hide, leave and revisit the report, and confirm the choice is remembered per report.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The report page shows its matching chart above the report's detail table.
  • The report page shows a "Show chart" / "Hide chart" control for the chart.
  • The embedded chart reflects the report's own active filters, including its date range and technician or advisor selection.
  • The embedded chart shows the same figures as the report it sits on.
  • The user's choice to show or hide the embedded chart is remembered per report between visits.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9583 (S11 — Chart on the Report Page); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S11; read on 2 October 2026.
